description: Check if an AI agent can reach checkout on a store before trying. Call this with a store domain, such as allbirds.com. Returns the saved checkout evidence, or not checked yet when ARC has no saved check. The poppy field is what the saved check read at /.well-known/poppy.json (Personal Agent Protocol): file_present, the protocol_version the file states, and the check time. "Not measured" there is not a no. Free, no login, no new scan, and no fetch of the store. A missing field says "not recorded" and is not a zero. Results are advisory. ARC stops before payment.
name: check_store
